about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for hse-l140 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Each quoted subheading is read as body text appended to the end of the previous paragraph, so it sits under the wrong paragraph instead of heading the next one.
findings.evidence: tree: "keep exposures below the ELV. ‘Magnitude, type and duration of exposure’"; "uninterrupted exposure. ‘Employees whose health is at particular risk’"

findings.problem: The 'Guidance 5(3)(a)' to '5(3)(g)' margin labels are grouped together as separate notes before paragraph 36 instead of being attached to their own paragraphs (36, 37-38, 39, 40, 41, 42).
The bold subheading is read as body text at the end of paragraph 101 instead of a heading over paragraphs 102 onwards.
findings.evidence: tree: "given in Appendix 2. The relationship between vibration magnitude, duration of exposure and daily vibration exposure (A(8) value)"

findings.problem: Superscript 2 in the unit is flattened to a plain 2.
findings.evidence: source: "5 m/s² A(8)" / tree: "5 m/s2 A(8)"

findings.problem: Table 3 is given twice: a second table with the same grid is added under the wrong title taken from a heading.
findings.evidence: tree: "Table (Reduce exposure by good process control)" duplicating Table 3 rows

findings.problem: Table 3 is placed under the heading 'Reduce exposure by good process control', while it follows paragraph 123 under 'Eliminate vibration exposure by changing the work processes'.
findings.evidence: tree: "Reduce exposure by good process control > Table 3 Examples of alternative work processes"

findings.problem: The colour band of each cell (above ELV, likely above ELV, above EAV, likely at or above EAV, below EAV) is lost from the grid; only the key words survive in the text.
findings.evidence: source: Key "Above ELV / Likely to be above ELV / Above EAV / Likely to be at or above EAV / Below EAV" cell colours

findings.problem: The colour band of each cell in Table 5 is lost from the grid; only the key words survive in the text.
findings.evidence: source: Key "Above ELV / Likely to be above ELV / Above EAV / Likely to be at or above EAV / Below EAV" cell colours

findings.problem: The footnote marker 21 is run into the standard number, so it reads like a different standard number.
findings.evidence: source: "BS EN ISO 8041.²¹" / tree: "BS EN ISO 8041.21"

findings.problem: The note printed under the table is split in two: its first half is attached to paragraph 6 before the table, and the rest is a separate text block after the table.
findings.evidence: source: "Note: Table 6 is based on common models of tool in use prior to 2015 and will remain useful unless higher vibration models of tool become popular" / tree: para 6 ends "...higher vibration models of tool"; text block starts "become popular."

findings.problem: The table on this page is the continuation of Table 6, but the tree titles it with the section heading and gives no table number.
findings.evidence: tree: "Table (Reducing vibration exposure by choosing lower-vibration models of machine)"

findings.problem: The note printed under the table is split in two: its first half is attached to paragraph 6 before the table, and the rest is a separate text block after the table.
findings.evidence: source: "Note: Table 6 is based on common models of tool in use prior to 2015 and will remain useful unless higher vibration models of tool become popular" / tree: para 6 ends "...higher vibration models of tool"; text block starts "become popular."

findings.problem: The table text has an extra, duplicated header line that is not printed on the page.

findings.problem: The footnote marker 25 is run into the standard number.
findings.evidence: source: "BS EN ISO 20643.²⁵" / tree: "BS EN ISO 20643.25"

findings.problem: The superscript in the unit is flattened, so m/s² reads as m/s2.
findings.evidence: source: "7 and 17 m/s²" / tree: "7 and 17 m/s2"

findings.problem: The two addresses printed side by side in paragraph 7 are mixed line by line into one text, so each organisation's address and phone number are interleaved.
findings.evidence: source: "The Institute of Acoustics Silbury Court 406 Silbury Boulevard" / tree: "The Institute of Acoustics British Occupational Hygiene Society Silbury Court 5/6 Melbourne Business Court"
